entities.name: Reza
entities.description: A young vedalken Azorius lawmage who is stranded in the Thinktank, befriends its inventors, declares the Thinktank an enclave under emergency law and becomes a mentor.

entities.name: Tagan
entities.description: A brindle-furred sphinx lawmage and Reza's mentor, who encourages him to travel and later steps down so he can mentor others.

entities.name: Hendrik Azmerak
entities.description: A large red-bearded human Thinktank chemister with a mechanical heart who shoots down Azorius thopters, and is named Grand Arbiter pro tem of the Thinktank Enclave.

entities.name: Janin
entities.description: A lithe human raised by vedalken, who keeps Hendrik's home running and helps Reza.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate, who praises Reza's law rune.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: The founding author of the Azorius and the Guildpact, a blue-maned figure whose draft Reza studies.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law and order whose lawmages, arresters and archons maintain jurisdiction.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of chemisters, one of four guilds claiming the Thinktank.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild whose raids ruined many neighborhoods shown on the old map.

entities.name: Thinktank
entities.description: A thirty-block tract of Ravnica run by rogue Izzet chemisters, with disputed jurisdiction, later declared an enclave.

entities.name: Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy
entities.description: A first-year lawmage problem about four guilds' competing claims to the Thinktank.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius guildhall where law runes are written in the sky.

entities.name: Old Laws Library
entities.description: A hard-to-reach library in the Jelenn Column complex holding original Azorius law texts, including Azor's Guildpact draft.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The founding law of Ravnica's guilds, whose first draft by Azor is displayed in the library.

entities.name: Thinktank Electrical Elemental
entities.description: An eighty-foot electrical elemental that emerges from a rift in the Thinktank and is subdued by Azorius nullmages.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Reza visits the Old Laws Library, where Tagan tells him the Senate adored his law rune and that Baan called it brilliant.
events.quote: They adored it. So intricate. So comprehensive.

events.summary: Tagan urges Reza to visit the Historical Archives in person to follow up with a new law, and he agrees despite his fear of flying.
events.quote: You should visit the Historical Archives yourself, while your rune is still new in the sky.

events.summary: Reza flies a griffin over Ravnica, passing his own law rune in the sky, and then is thrown when lightning shoots a thopter.
events.quote: I try to compensate so I can steady it, but my efforts make things worse, and I lose my grip.

events.summary: Reza falls into a pile of trash in the Thinktank and is helped by Hendrik, who explains a mad genius has been shooting down thopters.
events.quote: That was a mighty fall you took. You're lucky to be alive.

events.summary: Reza follows Hendrik home and meets Janin, who cleans his robes and offers vedalken cleansing oils.
events.quote: I'm Janin. I keep the gears from falling off in this little hovel.

events.summary: A vedalken mugger steals one of Reza's satchels, and when Reza seeks help at the edge of the Thinktank, Azorius arresters suspect him instead.
events.quote: He swipes at the strap of one of my satchels. It comes free, and then he's running off with my precious reference texts.

events.summary: Missing his identity rune, Reza throws a vial of cleansing oil at the arresters and flees, fearing arrest under his own new law.
events.quote: I retrieve it from the satchel, then throw it down at the arrester's feet.

events.summary: Hendrik and Janin rescue Reza in a thopter vehicle assembled from stolen Azorius parts, and Reza realizes Hendrik is the thopter shooter.
events.quote: You're the 'mad genius' who's been shooting down thopters!

events.summary: A huge electrical elemental emerges from a rift over the Thinktank workshop, and Azorius archons cannot act because of the jurisdiction dispute.
events.quote: More lightning lashes out of the rift as the elemental starts to take on a distinct form

events.summary: Reza invokes emergency law to name Hendrik Grand Arbiter pro tem and grants the Thinktank sovereignty so it can request Azorius help.
events.quote: By the prerogative writ of emergency, and by a unanimous vote, I hereby declare Hendrik Azmerak Grand Arbiter pro tem of the Thinktank Enclave.

events.summary: Azorius archons and nullmages subdue the elemental after Reza's law rune brings help.
events.quote: They work together to cast a blue dome of magic over the elemental

events.summary: After months of negotiation, Reza has solved the Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy with a fifty-seven page proposal.
events.quote: I'd solved the Fallacy. For real this time.

events.summary: Tagan tells Reza she can no longer be his mentor because it is time he becomes a mentor himself.
events.quote: I can't be your mentor anymore, because I think it's time you become a mentor yourself.

relations.note: She mentors him until the end.
relations.quote: Finally, I spot my mentor's blue and brown brindle fur
I'm Rezajaelis Agnaus, lawmage at New Prahv.
the connection between us goes deeper than mere acquaintances.
we chat about our favorite vedalken customs

relations.note: Named Grand Arbiter pro tem of the Thinktank Enclave.
relations.quote: declaring Hendrik Azmerak as Grand Arbiter pro tem
